hints.title: Search Range Boundaries
hints.text: The minimum possible subarray sum is min(nums) and maximum is sum(nums).

hints.title: Binary Search on Subarray Sum
hints.text: binary search on the target subarray sum value mid.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Sliding Window Predicate
hints.text: count how many subarrays have a sum less than or equal to mid using a two-pointer sliding window, since all array elements are positive.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: S: sum of all elements in nums
complexity.notes: Binary search on sum answer uses sliding window counting in O(N) per test.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all O(N^2) subarray sums and sorting them takes prohibitive time and memory for N = 20,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on sum answer with two-pointer predicate runs in O(N log(sum(nums))) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize monotonic subarray sums under positive numbers enabling sliding window counting.
